title: The Impossible Garden
author: Casper Delacroix
blurb: Ivo Ishikawa, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
